title: Cutting into 卷
html:
04 Juan

In: 03_pages_to_text/out/pages.jsonl. Out: out/lines.jsonl (every line of the body with its juan and page), out/juan.csv, out/juan/NNN.txt (for reading), out/front_matter.jsonl. Code: run.py.

Rule

The manuscript opens each juan with its title (大明孝宗敬皇帝實錄卷之七) and often closes it with the same title. We walk through the pages with a counter: a title with the next number opens that juan; a title with the current number closes it; anything else is reported. Only the number is read, because the OCR misreads the emperor's title (敬 as 欽, 教, 徽, 成).

Numbers

  • 224 of 224 juan found, 224 opening titles, 134 closing titles, no odd titles.
  • Front matter: 58 pages (preface, memorial of submission, rules, compilers, contents).
  • Body: 35,752 lines, 1,137,226 characters.
  • 12 margin labels that the OCR had put inside the text were removed.

Check: the margin label

The 1966 edition prints the juan in the margin of every page. The label was not used to cut. It agrees with our juan on 3,948 of 4,128 pages (95.6%); 19 labels could not be read. The 180 disagreements were looked at: they are misread labels (卷二一二 read as 二一一二 or 二一一, on alternate pages), not wrong cuts.

What went wrong

  • A title can break across two columns (juan 195 uses the full posthumous title).
  • A title can sit in the middle of a line (juan 196).
  • ○ is a numeral in the margin but a record mark in the text: the first pattern read "卷之一百九十六○弘治…" as juan 190.

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# ///
"""Step 04. Cut the page text into juan.

In:   03_pages_to_text/out/pages.jsonl
Out:  out/lines.jsonl        every line of the body: juan, page (seq), line number, text
      out/juan.csv           one row per juan: pages, title as read, characters, margin check
      out/juan/NNN.txt       the juan as plain text, for reading
      out/front_matter.jsonl pages before juan 1 (preface, memorial, compilers, contents)
      out/report.json

Rule.  The manuscript opens each juan with its title (大明孝宗敬皇帝實錄卷之七) and
often closes it with the same title, sometimes with 終.  We walk through the pages
in order and keep a counter:
  - a title with the next number opens that juan;
  - a title with the current number is the closing title;
  - anything else is reported and changes nothing.
Title lines are taken out of the text and recorded in juan.csv.  The emperor's
posthumous title is long and the OCR misreads it (敬 as 欽, 教, 徽), so the rule keys on
"…錄卷之N" and reads only the number.

Check.  The 1966 edition prints the juan in the margin of every page
(明孝宗實錄 卷一〇七).  That label was never used to cut.  For each page we compare
the label with the juan we assigned.  Labels the OCR misread are counted, not hidden.

Also here: margin labels that the OCR put inside the text block are removed
(a line that is exactly 明孝宗實錄 卷三七, and a leaf number alone on the next line).

Run:  uv run 04_juan/run.py
"""
import collections
import csv
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE / "lib"))
import manifest  # noqa: E402
from numerals import CHARS, to_int  # noqa: E402

PAGES = BASE / "03_pages_to_text" / "out" / "pages.jsonl"
OUT = HERE / "out"
LAST_JUAN = 224

NUM = f"[{CHARS}]+"
TITLE_NUM = "[一二三四五六七八九十百廿卅]+"       # no ○: in the text ○ is the record mark
# 大明孝宗敬皇帝實錄卷之一百九十五(終) — the long title may break across two columns
TITLE = re.compile(
    rf"(?:大?明?[孝考]宗[^\n○△]{{0,24}}?)[實寔審]?\n?[實寔審]?錄\s*卷\s*之?\s*({TITLE_NUM})\s*(終?)")
STRAY_MARGIN = re.compile(rf"^明孝宗實錄\s*卷?\s*[{CHARS}]*$")
MARGIN_JUAN = re.compile(rf"卷\s*之?\s*({NUM})")
CJK = re.compile(r"[㐀-鿿豈-﫿\U00020000-\U0003ffff]")


def clean_lines(text: str):
    """Drop margin labels that ended up in the text block."""
    out, dropped, prev_stray = [], 0, False
    for ln in text.split("\n"):
        if STRAY_MARGIN.match(ln) and "之" not in ln and "百" not in ln:
            dropped += 1
            prev_stray = True
            continue
        if prev_stray and len(ln) <= 3 and to_int(ln) is not None:      # the leaf number
            dropped += 1
            continue
        prev_stray = False
        out.append(ln)
    return out, dropped


def margin_juan(margin):
    for t in margin:
        m = MARGIN_JUAN.search(t.replace("\n", ""))
        if m and "明孝宗實錄" in t:
            return to_int(m[1])
    return None


def main() -> None:
    pages = [json.loads(l) for l in open(PAGES, encoding="utf-8")]
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (OUT / "juan").mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    cur = 0                                   # juan we are in; 0 = front matter
    lines = []                                # (juan, seq, text)
    info = collections.defaultdict(lambda: {"title": "", "closing": "", "first": "", "last": ""})
    odd, n = [], collections.Counter()
    page_juan = {}                            # seq -> set of juan on that page
    front = []

    def emit(seq, chunk):
        for ln in chunk.split("\n"):
            ln = ln.strip()
            if ln:
                lines.append((cur, seq, ln))
                page_juan.setdefault(seq, set()).add(cur)
                info[cur]["first"] = info[cur]["first"] or seq
                info[cur]["last"] = seq

    for p in pages:
        seq = p["seq"]
        kept, dropped = clean_lines(p["text"])
        n["stray_margin_lines_dropped"] += dropped
        text = "\n".join(kept)
        pos = 0
        for m in TITLE.finditer(text):
            num = to_int(m[1])
            title = m[0].replace("\n", "")
            if num == cur + 1 and num <= LAST_JUAN:
                if cur == 0:
                    front_text = text[:m.start()]
                    if front_text.strip():
                        front.append({"seq": seq, "text": front_text})
                else:
                    emit(seq, text[pos:m.start()])
                cur = num
                info[cur]["title"] = title
                if m[2]:
                    odd.append((seq, title, "opening title carries 終"))
                n["opening_titles"] += 1
            elif num == cur and cur > 0:
                emit(seq, text[pos:m.start()])
                info[cur]["closing"] = title
                n["closing_titles"] += 1
            else:
                odd.append((seq, title, f"number {num} while in juan {cur}: left in the text"))
                continue
            pos = m.end()
        if cur == 0:
            if text.strip() and pos == 0:
                front.append({"seq": seq, "status": p["status"], "margin": p["margin"], "text": text})
        else:
            emit(seq, text[pos:])
            if p["status"] not in ("ok", "no-text"):
                n[f"body_pages_{p['status']}"] += 1

    # margin check: label read from the page vs juan assigned
    agree = disagree = unread = 0
    mismatch = []
    for p in pages:
        seq = p["seq"]
        if seq not in page_juan:
            continue
        mj = margin_juan(p["margin"])
        if mj is None:
            unread += 1
        elif mj in page_juan[seq]:
            agree += 1
        else:
            disagree += 1
            mismatch.append({"seq": seq, "assigned": sorted(page_juan[seq]), "margin": p["margin"][:2]})

    with open(OUT / "lines.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        counter = collections.Counter()
        for j, seq, ln in lines:
            counter[j] += 1
            f.write(json.dumps({"juan": j, "seq": seq, "n": counter[j], "text": ln}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    chars = collections.Counter()
    by_juan = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for j, seq, ln in lines:
        by_juan[j].append(ln)
        chars[j] += len(CJK.findall(ln))
    with open(OUT / "juan.csv", "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(["juan", "first_page", "last_page", "pages", "lines", "chars", "title_as_read", "closing_title_as_read"])
        for j in range(1, LAST_JUAN + 1):
            i = info.get(j)
            if not i or not i["first"]:
                w.writerow([j, "", "", 0, 0, 0, i["title"] if i else "", ""])
                continue
            w.writerow([j, i["first"], i["last"], int(i["last"][4:]) - int(i["first"][4:]) + 1,
                        len(by_juan[j]), chars[j], i["title"], i["closing"]])
            (OUT / "juan" / f"{j:03d}.txt").write_text("\n".join(by_juan[j]) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with open(OUT / "front_matter.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in front:
            f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    found = sorted(j for j in info if info[j]["first"])
    numbers = {
        "juan_found": len(found),
        "juan_missing": [j for j in range(1, LAST_JUAN + 1) if j not in found],
        "front_matter_pages": len(front),
        "body_lines": len(lines), "body_chars": sum(chars.values()),
        **dict(n),
        "margin_check": {"pages_agree": agree, "pages_disagree": disagree, "label_not_read": unread},
        "odd_titles": [list(o) for o in odd],
        "margin_mismatch": mismatch,
    }
    (OUT / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(numbers, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    manifest.write(HERE, [PAGES], [OUT / "lines.jsonl", OUT / "juan.csv", OUT / "front_matter.jsonl", OUT / "report.json"],
                   {k: v for k, v in numbers.items() if k not in ("odd_titles", "margin_mismatch")})
    short = dict(numbers)
    short["odd_titles"] = f"{len(odd)} (see report.json)"
    short["margin_mismatch"] = f"{len(mismatch)} (see report.json)"
    print(json.dumps(short, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
